text: AlKifah Holding presents Tamweel Aloula among its financial-services investments on its website.

source.name: AlKifah Holding – Investments, Financial Services (company website)
source.quote: Based in the eastern province of Saudi Arabia, Tamweel AlOula was formed in 2007 with highly recognized foundation of professionalism in the field of financial services.
source.note: The Tamweel AlOula profile appears in the 'Our Investments' section under 'Financial Services' on AlKifah Holding's website. The page itself is undated; the date is the day it was opened.
